title: Intel results to test if AI-fueled rally has room to run
title_zh: 英特尔结果测试人工智能推动的反弹是否还有空间
summary: Intel's results on Thursday will show whether the American chip icon has the numbers to back a Wall Street rally that has ‌sent its shares nearly three times higher this year, as its turnaround ‌push wins over investors and the AI buildout powers demand.
summary_zh: 英特尔周四的业绩将显示，这家美国芯片巨头是否有足够的数据来支持华尔街的反弹，今年以来，随着英特尔的扭亏为盈赢得了投资者的青睐，以及人工智能的扩张推动了需求，该公司的股价今年已上涨近三倍。
